description:
Create one truthful inspectable activity model derived from child runtime events, replacing `turn N` as the dominant progress signal and separating activity from child speech/output.

## Background

Tool starts, text deltas, and turn ends already reach `AgentTree`, but `turn N` overwrites more useful state. `lastSaid` currently returns `lastActivity` first, conflating activity, messages, and output. Live tool events omit formatted arguments even though transcript rehydration can format them. Activity history grows without a bound, and arbitrary streamed prose/control sequences are unsuitable as canonical always-visible progress.

## Activity contract

Introduce a small internal snapshot, names flexible but semantics locked:

- phase: `starting | thinking | tool | waiting | settling`
- concise summary derived from trusted runtime events
- optional tool name/formatted safe argument preview
- turn count as metadata, not the primary summary
- `updatedAt` for elapsed/staleness rendering

Transitions:
- registration/pending → starting
- live handle / model work without active tool → thinking
- tool_execution_start → tool with `formatToolCall()`-quality preview
- tool_execution_end → thinking unless another explicit state wins
- child→parent question → waiting, remaining live
- first `agent_end` while idle is not committed → settling
- terminal status remains authoritative outside the activity snapshot

## Inspection semantics

- `lastActivity`/activity snapshot describes runtime work only.
- Actual parent/peer messages remain messages.
- Terminal assistant prose remains output.
- Remove or redefine `lastSaid` so it never reports `turn 3` or a tool call as speech. Prefer explicit fields (`activity`, `lastMessage`, terminal output preview) over another fallback chain.
- Do not use arbitrary text deltas as canonical phase/progress. If retained for drill-down, sanitize control characters, bound length, and label it narrative preview.
- Keep a bounded in-memory recent-activity ring (choose and test a modest fixed cap). Full JSONL child transcript remains canonical; no new configuration knob.
- Rehydrated history must reconstruct equivalent activity summaries from session events where possible.

## Scope / likely files

- `packages/pi-minions/src/types.ts`, `tree.ts`
- `subsessions/types.ts`, `subsessions/manager.ts`, transcript parsing
- spawn runner and orchestrate callbacks
- `tools/minions.ts`, packet fleet snapshots, existing observability drill-down
- focused unit/integration tests

## Acceptance behavior

- A running child reading a file shows a bounded formatted read path, not `turn N`.
- Turn completion preserves useful phase/summary and updates turn metadata.
- Waiting-on-parent is explicit and remains running.
- `list_minions` and `show_minion` expose separate activity/message/output concepts.
- History never exceeds the cap; full transcript inspection still works.
- Control sequences and multiline untrusted prose cannot corrupt persistent TUI lines.
- Spawn and orchestrated children share the activity model; only orchestrated children participate in group packets.

## Do not

- Require children to send progress reports.
- Parse terminal prose into success/status.
- Add activity-format settings before a concrete need.
- Change settled/failed/aborted terminal semantics.

## Tests and validation

Cover every phase transition, trusted tool formatting, message/output separation, history cap, transcript rehydration, control-character sanitization, and no `turn N` overwrite regression. Run pi-minions lint/test/typecheck. Commit atomically with this issue id.

comments.text: Independent review of 9d21675 found one stated blocker plus several findings parent elevates because they directly violate this ticket's locked acceptance. FIX: waiting must clear on accepted parent reply/resumed model work and later agent_end must enter settling; prove mailbox→waiting→reply/work→thinking→agent_end→settling through runtime integration. FIX: share guarded transition ordering so spawn cannot clobber an already-started tool with a late thinking update. FIX: outward packet activity must be a bounded trusted projection, excluding narrativePreview/raw toolName, and snapshots/history/packet payloads must not share mutable aliases. FIX: live vs rehydrated waiting must represent accepted parent-bound questions truthfully (not merely tool start), and malformed JSONL must skip bad records without discarding valid later history. FIX: foreground spawn rendering must consume the shared activity model beyond tool-start. FIX: add user-visible list/show, ANSI/multiline tool-arg, waiting/resume/settling, malformed replay regressions. REJECTED as non-contract issues: unused isActivityPhase export, pre-existing tmp parser, preserved last-tool summary while thinking, restore-time updatedAt, and terminal-status separation (already correct). Ticket remains blocked pending fix + re-review.

title: Replace turn counters with bounded runtime-derived activity state
